method: Three alternating E4/E5 pairs, separate source exports, identical guarded driver, isolated state, fixed engine time, 10 s Git delay; cold initialization and two warm sweeps reported separately. Byte totals include complete roots, lazy row headers and individual attempt copies. CPU is Viewer main-thread CPU, at 100 ticks/s. Timer observations include instrument overhead.

outputWriteProbe.fixture: Same raw SQL output update on the same synthetic retained attempts. Three writes per size. The full production-shaped growth fixture also reproduced a 12,849 ms mutation lease on the reviewed candidate.

regressions.reviewedCandidate: Both new retry and whole-phase regressions failed; 8,272 attempt visits at 4,096 attempts; a new host became unconfirmed after one failed stop.
regressions.fixed: Each new terminal host receives five failed-stop opportunities across bounded windows and a real process restart; off-window activation and survivor guards remain protective. Growth also retains a settled key for every attempt.
